about: The reindeer or caribou (Rangifer tarandus): grey-brown with a cream neck and mane, a white rump and belly, dark legs and face with white above the hooves; paler toward the high Arctic, darker in the woods. White reindeer (recessive) turn up in some herds. Both sexes grow antlers, a cow's smaller; calves are plain brown, not spotted.

loci.name: Paleness
loci.about: dark brown (a woodland caribou's) to pale grey (a high-Arctic one's)

loci.name: Size
loci.about: small to big for its kind and sex (inherited, like height in people: many genes, each a little)

loci.name: Curiosity
loci.about: aloof to curious: whether it comes to look at a player standing still nearby instead of keeping away

loci.name: Fierceness
loci.about: timid to fierce: a hunter's eagerness to hunt and to keep at a chase, a plant eater's readiness to stand its ground
